title: CTA + vite/vue fails on npm 6 due to `set-script`
body:
**Describe the bug**
CTA fails on a vite recipe with npm@6. It appears to fail on `set-script` which is only available in npm@7.

**Platform and Versions (please complete the following information):**
<!-- You can use the `tauri info` command to get this information -->

Node: ?
NPM: 6
Yarn: n/a
Rustc: n/a
